description: This file defines a helper class '_parse_lockinfo' for parsing LOCK request bodies in a WebDAV server context. It includes methods for XML parsing, handling lock type, scope, and owner information.

classes.name: _parse_lockinfo
classes.description: A class for parsing LOCK request bodies in WebDAV, extracting lock type, scope, and owner information from XML input.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the parser, reads XML from a file stream, and extracts lock information.

methods.name: _startElement
methods.description: Handles the start of an XML element, updating lock type, scope, and owner collection state.

methods.name: _data
methods.description: Handles character data within XML, appending owner data when in owner collection mode.

methods.name: _endElement
methods.description: Handles the end of an XML element, finalizing owner data collection.
